channel.title: Zakhwan Anuar Blog
channel.description: Notes and thoughts on cybersecurity, CTF, and building security tools.

item.title: ChameleonFW: Building an ESP32-S3 WiFi Research Rig
item.description: A captive-portal / rogue-AP research tool that runs entirely on a $10 ESP32-S3 and is driven from your phone. Here is how the firmware actually works — the DNS hijack, the soft-AP, credential capture, and flash-persisted config.

item.title: DiscordC2Dump: Turning a Recovered Bot Token into Threat Intel
item.description: Malware increasingly uses Discord as a command-and-control channel. When you pull a bot token and guild ID out of a sample in the lab, this Python tool walks the Discord REST API to dump everything the bot can see and scan it for IOCs.

item.title: Building a Bad USB: What a $5 Pico Taught Me About HID Attacks
item.description: A Raspberry Pi Pico running CircuitPython that enumerates as a USB HID keyboard and runs a DuckyScript payload — a full breakdown of the boot-time USB toggle, the payload parser, the key map, and the GP0 arming logic.

item.title: A Visit to CyberSecurity Malaysia: My Last Event Leading MBOT
item.description: My final event leading the MBOT UNITEN Student Chapter — a visit to CyberSecurity Malaysia in Cyberjaya, and a reflection on growth, leadership, and becoming someone new.

item.title: Speaking at CyberShield Summit 2026
item.description: How one simple conversation led to speaking at a national-level cybersecurity summit — sharing CTF, cybersecurity, and the Malaysia Board of Technologists with 360+ students across the country.

item.title: MBOT CodeRush 2026: An Experiment in Letting Go
item.description: No code, no competition results. Just a reflection on stepping back, trusting others, and discovering that the best leadership sometimes means giving others the space to lead.

item.title: Scholarship Journey: From Rejections to Peace
item.description: No CTF, no cybersecurity. Just an email that brought me back to one of the hardest chapters of my life — rejections, pressure, guilt, and eventually, peace.

item.title: The Micromanagement Trap in Leadership
item.description: A reflection from my conversation with a colleague at Southeast Asia Sustainable Environmental Leadership Program 2025 (SEASEL'25) on why micromanaging erodes trust — and what it really means to lead with confidence instead of control.

item.title: My First CTF: What I Expected vs Reality
item.description: I thought my first CTF would be like in the movies. It was not. But I learned more in 48 hours than in weeks of studying.

item.title: Tools I Actually Use (and Why)
item.description: A no-fluff list of the tools that actually end up in my CTF workflow — with honest notes on when they're useful and when they're not.
